chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn Mahziyar, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Sa'id, from Zarif ibn Nasih, from Khalid Al-Qalanisi, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: One prayer in the Mosque of Kufah is equal to one thousand prayers.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying in the Mosque of Kufah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the unique spiritual status of the Mosque of Kufah, a site deeply intertwined with the history of Imam Ali (AS) and the Ahl al-Bayt. The multiplier of one thousand prayers reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of locations associated with the Imams, linking physical worship to historical reverence and divine favor.
